name: pshenok/server-survival
embed_notes: index.html + ES-module src/, no bundler; loads three.js and tailwind from CDNs (vendor them locally for iframe/CSP).
reskin_notes: Procedural 3D meshes (no sprite files); 26 service names/descriptions live in src/config.js + src/locales (i18n) so renaming to sponsor mascots is config-driven; colors in style.css/config.
score_hook: src/state.js holds budget/reputation/time; explicit Game Over when reputation hits 0 or budget < -1000 -> wrap in postMessage.
notes: By far the biggest OSS TD on GitHub (6.4k stars, very active); Survival/Campaign/Sandbox modes.

name: oldj/html5-tower-defense
embed_notes: Open src/td.html or build/td.html directly; zero deps.
reskin_notes: Entirely canvas-drawn shapes (no image assets) - reskin = editing draw code & colors; UI text is Chinese.
score_hook: Global game object tracks money/lives/wave; game-over branch in js - easy to patch a postMessage.
notes: Classic Desktop-TD style clone, MIT, 385 stars; dormant since 2019 but tiny and self-contained.

name: maciej-trebacz/tower-of-time-game
games: Tower of Time (TD with time rewind)
embed_notes: npm install && vite build -> static dist; Phaser Editor project.
reskin_notes: All sprites/tilesets/audio are loose files in public/assets (player.png, octonid.png, asset-pack.json) - drop-in swaps; UI font Orbitron.ttf.
score_hook: ECS-style src/systems + scenes; wave/energy/base-HP state in scenes - add postMessage on game-over scene.
notes: Polished 2025 jam TD, MIT, 371 stars; ~95% AI-written (author's PoC) so code is plain and greppable.

name: channingallen/tower-defense
embed_notes: Ember-CLI app (2016 era, bower) - painful build; DOM-based.
reskin_notes: Towers are DOM elements styled with CSS - easy CSS reskin, but see license.
score_hook: Ember state tracks waves/lives - patchable.
notes: FLAG: NO LICENSE (609 stars) - unusable without author permission. Listed for completeness (Flexbox Defense, the CSS-learning TD).

name: danprince/norman-the-necromancer
embed_notes: Vite build to single small bundle; 13KB game.
reskin_notes: Single tiny pixel sprite/font sheet (font.png) and procedural drawing - swapping art means re-drawing a micro sprite sheet.
score_hook: Wave counter and player HP in src game state; death -> game over screen, easy to instrument.
notes: Unlicense (public domain), 200 stars, very polished js13k 2022 entry; wave-defense feel close to Stick War lite.

name: baterson/svelte-tower-defence
embed_notes: SvelteKit static build.
reskin_notes: Everything is DOM/CSS + images in static/ - CSS variables & image swaps give a full reskin.
score_hook: Svelte stores hold gold/lives/wave - subscribe and postMessage.
notes: MIT, 50 stars; unusual DOM-only TD which makes sponsor theming trivially CSS-driven.

name: victorqribeiro/towerDefense
embed_notes: Plain index.html + js/ + assets; PWA service worker (disable sw.js when embedding).
reskin_notes: Sprites in img/, music/ & soundfx/ folders, maps in map.json + levelGenerator - clean asset separation.
score_hook: Lives/money/wave globals in js/; game over path easy to hook.
notes: Only 28 stars but exceptionally clean, asset-separated vanilla TD (same author as many small OSS games).

name: JoshTheDerf/Incredibots-2-HTML5-Open-Source
embed_notes: Vite build; large port of the original Flash game with resource/ assets.
reskin_notes: UI skins & art in resource/ and site-resource/; game is a sandbox so 'reskin' is mostly UI/branding.
score_hook: Challenge/level completion events in src; no simple score var - medium effort.
notes: FLAG: custom copyleft-ish IncrediFriends license (NOASSERTION) - review before commercial use. Genuine Flash-era title ported to HTML5, active 2026.

name: tonikolaba/AngryBirds
embed_notes: index.html + js/ + sprites/; no build.
reskin_notes: All art in sprites/ folder (birds, pigs, blocks) - straight PNG swaps for mascot birds.
score_hook: Score variable and level-complete/fail checks in js/ - simple to hook.
notes: MIT, 18 stars, 2017; small but the cleanest permissive Angry-Birds-style launcher found (most others are Unity).

name: doublespeakgames/adarkroom
embed_notes: Static index.html; runs from file or any host; optional Dropbox sync can be removed.
reskin_notes: Text-only game: all strings in lang/*.po + script/ - full re-theming = rewriting copy (no sprites); CSS trivial.
score_hook: script/scoring.js computes a numeric score; engine.js events fire on ending/prestige - ideal postMessage point.
notes: 8.2k stars, MPL-2.0 (weak copyleft, file-level - fine for embedding). The archetypal incremental; 25+ languages.

name: pmotschmann/Evolve
embed_notes: node buildEvolve.js bundles; static after build.
reskin_notes: Enormous data-driven game (evolve/ + lib/), DOM/text only; theming via CSS is easy but content is deeply interlinked.
score_hook: global.stats / prestige resets exposed on window.global - can poll for 'score'.
notes: 1.2k stars, MPL-2.0, updated daily; too deep for casual arcade but a strong 'idle' anchor title.

name: particle-clicker/particle-clicker
embed_notes: Static site (index.html, js/, json/); no build.
reskin_notes: Upgrades/workers/research/achievements are pure JSON in json/ - rename everything to sponsor items without touching code; assets/ holds images.
score_hook: js/game.js state (data, clicks) + storage.js; easy to expose totals via postMessage.
notes: 683 stars, MIT, made at CERN Webfest; the most data-driven Cookie-Clicker-style clicker found.

name: IvarK/AntimatterDimensionsSourceCode
embed_notes: npm ci && npm run build; heavy bundle; Steam-related code can be ignored.
reskin_notes: Famous deep incremental; images in public/images, but text/themes are spread across hundreds of Vue components.
score_hook: player object global (window.player) with antimatter/infinities etc - pollable; no single game-over.
notes: 380 stars, MIT - the official source of one of the most-played incrementals; brand value high, reskin cost high.

name: Pseudo-Corp/SynergismOfficial
embed_notes: Makefile/esbuild build to static; some optional login/cloud-save code to strip.
reskin_notes: Pictures/ holds all icons (Default/, Legacy/ themes exist!), but game text is inline in TS.
score_hook: player object exported from src/Synergism.ts - pollable for quarks/ascensions.
notes: 370 stars, MIT, active 2026; official source of a top Kongregate-era incremental.

name: sparticle999/SpaceCompany
embed_notes: Static index.html + js files; no build (Grunt optional).
reskin_notes: data/ folder holds resource/building/tech definitions; Icons/ folder for art - moderately data-driven.
score_hook: Game.statistics / Game.resources globals; no game-over, poll for 'score'.
notes: 366 stars, MIT (LICENCE.txt), Kongregate-era hit; last push 2025.

name: Trimps/Trimps.github.io
embed_notes: Static; includes Kongregate_Game_Shell.html & Playfab/ (portal-integration precedent).
reskin_notes: Mostly text/DOM, few images in imgs/; content hardcoded in main.js (huge).
score_hook: window.game.global holds all stats; existing Kongregate stat-submission hooks show exactly where to postMessage.
notes: FLAG GPL-2.0. 283 stars, famous idle; its Kongregate shell is a useful reference for score-submission hooks.

name: ihtasham42/progress-knight
embed_notes: 3 files: index.html, css/, js/ - trivially embeddable.
reskin_notes: Text-only life-sim; jobs/skills/items are data tables in js/classes.js & main.js - rename to sponsor theme easily; CSS-only visuals.
score_hook: gameData global (coins, days, evil) and rebirth/prestige functions - easy to postMessage on rebirth.
notes: 175 stars, Unlicense (public domain), extremely forkable (many themed forks exist).

name: Acamaeda/The-Modding-Tree
embed_notes: Static; define your game in js/layers.js & js/mod.js.
reskin_notes: Purpose-built for making your own incremental: layers, names, colors, resources all declared in one config file.
score_hook: player object global; tmt hooks (doReset, hasUpgrade) - simple to wrap.
notes: 132 stars, MIT; not a game itself but the fastest path to a fully sponsor-branded incremental.

name: miktaew/yet-another-idle-rpg
embed_notes: build.js -> dist/ (dist committed); static after.
reskin_notes: resources/img for art, locales/ for strings - decent separation; enemies/items defined in src data files.
score_hook: character/xp state in src; no explicit game over - poll.
notes: 111 stars, MIT, active 2026; idle-RPG flavour (Melvor-lite).

name: candybox2/candybox2.github.io
embed_notes: compile.sh with tsc; ASCII-art game, static after build.
reskin_notes: ASCII art in ascii/ folder - re-theming = editing text art; no sprites.
score_hook: Global candies/lollipops counters; save/load functions - hookable.
notes: FLAG GPL-3.0 (license only in source header, GitHub shows NONE). 610 stars; cult Flash-era-web classic.

name: owenashurst/agar.io-clone
embed_notes: NEEDS SERVER: node server + socket.io; Dockerfile included; client is static once served.
reskin_notes: src/client/img, css and config.js (colors, names, food count) - skins are simple; cell rendering is canvas circles.
score_hook: Server tracks mass per player and emits 'RIP' / leaderboard events - postMessage from client on death with final mass.
notes: 2.97k stars, MIT, updated 2025; the canonical OSS agar.io.

name: vzhou842/example-.io-game
embed_notes: NEEDS SERVER: tiny express+socket.io; webpack build for client.
reskin_notes: public/assets contains ship.svg & bullet.svg - sponsor mascot = 1 SVG; constants in src/shared/constants.js.
score_hook: Server sends 'gameOver' event to client & score in state updates - trivial postMessage.
notes: 452 stars, MIT; deliberately minimal teaching codebase (Victor Zhou) - best starting point for a custom .io.

name: jespertheend/splix
embed_notes: NEEDS SERVER: Deno gameServer; client/ is static HTML.
reskin_notes: Client canvas draws colored blocks; skins/colors in client/src; json/ - re-theming via palette & UI images.
score_hook: Client receives death + score/blocks captured from server - hook in client death handler.
notes: 54 stars, MIT, active 2026 - the actual splix.io source released by its author (real Flash-era .io hit).

name: HasangerGames/suroi
embed_notes: NEEDS SERVER: heavy client/server monorepo (bun); production-grade.
reskin_notes: Large atlas of SVG/PNG assets in client/public - skins system already exists (cosmetics).
score_hook: Client game-over screen receives kills/rank/damage - hook there.
notes: FLAG GPL-3.0. 495 stars, very active; biggest OSS surviv.io clone.

name: nepphhh/arrasio
embed_notes: NEEDS SERVER: node server in arrasio/; client bundled via webpack.
reskin_notes: Tank definitions/colors in arrasio/src config files; UI text in client - data-driven tank tree.
score_hook: Server tracks score/level per tank; death message to client - hookable.
notes: FLAG GPL-3.0. 52 stars, stale since 2021, but it is the full open source of arras.io (diep.io style). (Newer Arras CE is PolyForm-Noncommercial - avoid.)

name: bibhuticoder/snake.io
embed_notes: Plain index.html + js/ - no server needed.
reskin_notes: Snake drawn procedurally (colors in js/), a couple of PNGs; UI text in index.html.
score_hook: Score/length variable in js/game code; death handler - easy.
notes: 48 stars, MIT; only permissive single-player slither found (knagaitsev/slither.io-clone has 264 stars but NO LICENSE).

name: tsherif/space-shooter.c
embed_notes: site/ contains a prebuilt .wasm/.js/.data - drop in an iframe as-is; rebuilding needs emscripten.
reskin_notes: Sprites in assets/sprites but packed into space-shooter.data at build time - swapping art requires an emscripten rebuild.
score_hook: Score lives in C game state; would need an EM_JS/ccall export - hard (1/5).
notes: 1.4k stars, MIT; polished but WASM makes reskin/score hooks costly.

name: taisei-project/taisei
embed_notes: Official web build via meson+emscripten (emscripten/ dir); big assets; official playable web version exists.
reskin_notes: Resources are loose files (atlas/, resources) but packed for web; characters are Touhou-fan characters - heavy to re-theme.
score_hook: Score/hiscore in C; would need exported hooks - hard.
notes: 1.6k stars, MIT (COPYING.txt) - the best OSS bullet hell anywhere, but WASM + fan-content make it a stretch for sponsor reskins.

name: jackrugile/radius-raid-js13k
embed_notes: index.html + js/ (17 small files); min.html single-file version too.
reskin_notes: 100% procedural vector graphics & jsfxr audio - reskin = palette/shape changes in definitions.js, no sprite swaps.
score_hook: js/game.js tracks score/level/hero HP with explicit game-over state + localStorage best - one-line postMessage.
notes: 273 stars, MIT; iconic js13k shooter, feels very Flash-arcade.

name: BKcore/HexGL
embed_notes: Static; serve folder; uses appcache (remove). Two texture sets (textures/ and textures.full/).
reskin_notes: textures/ships, hud, tracks are loose PNGs - ship & HUD rebrand is straightforward; track geometry is 3D.
score_hook: bkcore/hexgl gameplay tracks lap times/finish - hook race end.
notes: 1.7k stars, MIT; the flagship HTML5 racing demo.

name: jakesgordon/javascript-racer
embed_notes: v4.final.html + common.js + images/; no build.
reskin_notes: images/sprites.png + sprites.js atlas and background.png - swap cars/billboards/roadside for sponsor art; billboards are literal ad space.
score_hook: Lap time, position and 'currentLapTime' vars in v4.final.html - easy postMessage on lap/finish.
notes: 1.2k stars, MIT; classic tutorial racer with built-in roadside billboards (perfect for sponsor placement).

name: CiaranMcCann/Worms-Armageddon-HTML5-Clone
embed_notes: Old tsc build (2018); single-player works static; networking/ optional.
reskin_notes: data/images & data/sounds are loose files - worm sprites, weapons, terrain swappable.
score_hook: Team/Worm health in src; GameStateManager detects win - hookable.
notes: 317 stars, Apache-2.0; the most complete OSS Worms in the browser (dormant).

name: zenoamaro/ravaged-planet
embed_notes: index.html + src/ + assets/; no build.
reskin_notes: assets/ for art; tanks/weapons mostly procedural; palette in src.
score_hook: Round/winner logic in src/game - hook on match end.
notes: 25 stars, MIT; cleanest permissive Scorched Earth found.

name: feichao93/battle-city
embed_notes: yarn build -> static; has level editor.
reskin_notes: Two sprite sheets in resources/ (General-Sprites.png) rendered via SVG components - swap sheet or edit components.
score_hook: Redux store holds score/lives/stage; saga on game-over - dispatch postMessage from store subscriber.
notes: 1.9k stars, MIT (repo moved from shinima to feichao93); superb Tank-Trouble/Battle-City style game.

name: brianrisk/SYNTHBLAST-threejs-game
embed_notes: Vite build; assets/ + music/.
reskin_notes: Procedural neon 3D; colors/materials in js/; music files swappable.
score_hook: Score/wave in js game loop; game over screen - hookable.
notes: 141 stars, Apache-2.0, active 2026.

name: Kevin-Liu-01/Claude-of-Tanks
embed_notes: Vite build; optional multiplayer rooms via api/; large.
reskin_notes: 111 procedural vehicles - no sprite files; branding (public/brand) is separate; LICENSE-POLICY reserves some brand content.
score_hook: Match end / kill stats in game state - hookable.
notes: FLAG: MIT with proprietary content exceptions (brand assets). 139 stars, pushed today; mostly AI-generated codebase.

name: MattSurabian/DuckHunt-JS
embed_notes: dist/ is committed (duckhunt.js + sprites.png/json + audio) - iframe dist/index.html directly.
reskin_notes: TexturePacker sprite sheet (dist/sprites.json) and src/data/levels.json - swap duck/dog art for mascot; levels are JSON.
score_hook: src/modules/Game.js & Hud.js track score/kills; explicit game-over/win flow - easy postMessage.
notes: 630 stars, MIT, still maintained (2026); the definitive HTML5 Duck Hunt.

name: MattSkala/html5-bombergirl
embed_notes: index.html + js/ + img/ + sound/; bower dep for EaselJS (vendored).
reskin_notes: img/ has separate PNGs per character/tile/bomb/bonus - swap-friendly.
score_hook: GameEngine.js tracks player alive/bots left with gameOver() - hook there.
notes: 164 stars, MIT; simple single-player Bomberman with bots.

name: jakesgordon/javascript-boulderdash
embed_notes: index.html + boulderdash.js + caves.js; no build.
reskin_notes: images/ sprite sheet; caves defined as data in caves.js.
score_hook: Score & diamonds collected per cave in boulderdash.js - easy.
notes: FLAG: NO LICENSE (112 stars) and uses original C64 art - unusable as-is; best-known HTML5 Boulder Dash.

name: tomsoftware/Lemmings.ts
license: MIT code only (verified LICENSE; game data copyrighted)
embed_notes: npm build; REQUIRES the original Lemmings game data files (not included) - engine only.
reskin_notes: Reads original DAT/level files; art comes from copyrighted originals - reskin would mean authoring a full new data set.
score_hook: Level win/lose events in engine - hookable.
notes: FLAG: MIT code but depends on copyrighted game data. 110 stars; excellent engine, not deployable without content.

name: daleharvey/helicopter
embed_notes: index.html + js/ + assets/; no build.
reskin_notes: assets/ folder for art; simple.
score_hook: Distance score var in js/ - trivial.
notes: FLAG: NO LICENSE (93 stars, Dale Harvey/Mozilla). Only notable Copter clone; Copter is so simple a clean-room rewrite is <200 lines.

name: ChineseDron/fruit-ninja
embed_notes: release/ has playable build; source/ raw.
reskin_notes: Fruit/blade images as separate files.
score_hook: Score & lives in game code.
notes: FLAG: NO LICENSE (427 stars, 2012). Highest-starred JS Fruit Ninja; needs permission or rewrite (ishaanSh06/BlockNinja is a 21-star BSD-3 alternative).

name: 111116/webosu
embed_notes: Static site, but beatmaps come from an external API/CDN (api.js) - you host beatmap packs yourself.
reskin_notes: Skin system (skin/ assets, hit-circle images, fonts) - osu! skins are a well-understood reskin format.
score_hook: Score/accuracy/combo in play logic with results screen - hook results.
notes: 651 stars, MIT (some assets CC-BY-NC - check); best OSS web rhythm game for Guitar-Hero-like reflex play.

name: FunkinCrew/Funkin
embed_notes: lime build html5 -> static; heavy Haxe toolchain; official web release lives on Newgrounds.
reskin_notes: Characters/stages are data + spritesheets in the separate funkin.assets repo (restricted license); code is Apache-2.0.
score_hook: PlayState score/combo/health; song-end events - hookable in Haxe.
notes: FLAG: code Apache-2.0 but assets NOT open (FNF trademark). 3.7k stars, Newgrounds-native phenomenon - only usable as a mod-style reskin with all-new assets.

name: cwtickle/danoniplus
embed_notes: Static; charts are text data; music files in music/.
reskin_notes: Has an explicit skin/ directory + img/ - designed for player-authored skins; charts are simple text.
score_hook: Result screen exposes score/judgements; danoni_main.js has result-display function to hook.
notes: 45 stars, MIT, updated 2026 (long-lived Japanese project); the most reskin-ready rhythm engine found.

name: dmcinnes/dead-valley
embed_notes: index.html + lib/ + assets/ + maps/; includes a level editor.
reskin_notes: assets/ sprites & maps/ tiles are loose files.
score_hook: Player health/kills in lib/ - game over screen hookable.
notes: FLAG: NO LICENSE (66 stars). Closest to Boxhead found; needs author permission.

name: ricardo-foundry/canvas-vampire-survivors
embed_notes: Single index.html + JS files; no build.
reskin_notes: Procedural shapes; enemy/weapon stats in BALANCE.md-driven data - recolor only.
score_hook: Run timer/kills/xp with explicit game over - easy.
notes: Only 2 stars but MIT, active 2026, zero deps; the only permissive Survivors-like in JS found. Consider as a base.

name: wangzifan396-wzf/mini-browser-games
games: 124 single-file games incl. tank-arena, drift-racer, fruit-slice, mole-market (whack-a-mole), starforge-idle, fishing-harbor, clockwork-escape, stack-tower, mine-matrix
embed_notes: Each game is one self-contained .html - iframe individually.
reskin_notes: Inline CSS/JS per file; art is mostly canvas-drawn/emoji - reskin = editing each file's palette/strings (Chinese UI).
score_hook: Each file has its own score var; no shared API - per-game patch.
notes: MULTI-GAME COLLECTION (MIT, active 2026): 124 zero-dependency arcade/puzzle games with tiered quality ratings; covers whack-a-mole, racing, idle, fishing, escape, slicing in one repo.

name: KilledByAPixel/LittleJS
games: examples: breakout, platformer, puzzle, stress, box2d, three.js demos (+ separate SpaceHuggers, BounceBack games by same author)
embed_notes: Engine + examples run static (examples/ each has index.html); ES module or single-file builds.
reskin_notes: Engine designed for tile-sheet swaps (one tiles.png per example) - very reskin-friendly; author's games are separate repos (SpaceHuggers MIT, BounceBack GPL).
score_hook: Engine has no score API but games are tiny; postMessage patch trivial.
notes: MULTI-GAME COLLECTION / engine (4.2k stars, MIT, active): best base if the team decides to build its own Flash-style minigames fast.

name: MonkeyGG2/monkeygg2.github.io
games: 150+ hosted games (A Dark Room, Cookie Clicker, Clicker Heroes, 1v1.lol, Awesome Tanks, 10 Minutes Till Dawn, ...)
embed_notes: Static portal: config.jsonc + add-game-entry.js register games in games/<slug>/ - a working arcade-portal shell.
reskin_notes: Portal chrome is themeable, but the hosted games are mostly ripped commercial/unlicensed HTML5 builds.
score_hook: No score API; per-game.
notes: MULTI-GAME COLLECTION - FLAG: WTFPL shell but the bundled games are largely unlicensed copies (legal risk); useful only as a reference for portal structure (unmaintained).
